newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish minimum monthly wage set at 391 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Polish minimum monthly wage set at 391 zlotys.

text.p: The Polish labour ministry on Tuesday increased the minimum monthly wage for the first quarter of 1997 to 391 zlotys from the current 370 zlotys despite trade union demands for a higher rise.

The ministry's press offfice said the three-sided commission comprised of the government, trade unions and employers' groups failed to agree on the minimum wage on Monday and the minister had to determine it by himself.
It said the two biggest unions, the Solidarity and the OPZZ union, had wanted to set the minimum wage at 400 zlotys.
The average monthly wage in Poland's enterprise sector was 1,071 zlotys in November.
